name: Juyuan Tower
description: Juyuan Tower has a long history. It was first built in the second year of Song Xining (1069). It is known as the "Four Famous Towers in Jiangnan" together with Yellow Crane Tower, Yueyang Tower and Tengwang Pavilion. It is an important treasure of traditional Chinese architecture. It is located in Dexing City, Jiangxi Province. It is named Juyuan Tower because you can have a panoramic view of the whole city when you climb the tower. The famous writer Su Shi once visited the tower and wrote a "Poem in Ode to Juyuan Tower", which was widely spread throughout the world. In the year of Jianyan (1127), Emperor Gaozong of the Song Dynasty appreciated the poem deeply and awarded him a gold plaque "Juyuan Tower". The talented man wrote a poem, the emperor gave him a plaque, and Juyuan Tower became famous all over the world.
